title: Highlight Kheda Satyagraha 1918
definition: The Kheda Satyagraha was the first non-cooperation movement in India, organized by Mahatma Gandhi in the Kheda district of Gujarat to protest against the British government's refusal to remit land revenue despite crop failure.
importanceInUpsc: It marks the transition of Gandhi from a local agitator to a national leader and demonstrates the application of Satyagraha in a peasant-led agrarian crisis.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Highlight Kheda Satyagraha 1918.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Land Revenue Systems in British India
